purpose: Seed registry for nationwide observed EV charging-session acquisition. Candidate status does not imply licensing, access, or site-level session availability.

national_candidates.name: Joint Office EV-ChART
national_candidates.notes: Quarterly charging-session data are collected for federally funded infrastructure. Raw portal access is limited to funding recipients/authorized parties; public outputs are aggregated/anonymized. Hunt state recipient publications and public reports, not restricted raw records.

national_candidates.name: DOE Livewire / EV WATTS
national_candidates.notes: Nationwide real-world EVSE dataset and analytics include sessions, utilization and energy. Verify current downloadable geographic resolution and reuse terms before ingest.

national_candidates.name: California Energy Commission funded-project reporting
national_candidates.notes: CEC-funded projects submit detailed utilization/session data. Individual-charger utilization may be confidential, but public grant/project reports can contain publishable site/project aggregates.

national_candidates.name: Stable Auto
national_candidates.notes: Markets nationwide utilization intelligence based on real charging operating data. Requires commercial evaluation and explicit purchasing authority before any paid integration.

national_candidates.name: AFDC charging-network directory
national_candidates.notes: Strong national inventory/network directory for identifying operators and station IDs. Inventory is not session telemetry and must never be promoted to observed usage.
